statement: theorem killed_fiftytwo_primary_projectors {A : Type} (act : Nat → A → A) (plus : A → A → A) (zero : A) (mul : ∀ m n x, act (m*n) x=act m (act n x)) (sum : ∀ m n x, act (m+n) x=plus (act m x) (act n x)) (one : ∀ x, act 1 x=x) (zeroStable : ∀ n, act n zero=zero) (addZero : ∀ x, plus x zero=x) (x : A) (killed : act 52 x=zero) : x=plus (act 13 x) (act 40 x) ∧ act 4 (act 13 x)=zero ∧ act 13 (act 40 x)=zero ∧ (∀ z, act 4 z=zero → act 13 z=zero → z=zero)

theorem quotient_factor_and_twice_chain {A B J L : Type} (phiOld : A → J) (normOld : J → A) (gamma : A → B) (phiNew : B → L) (doubleJ : J → J) (zeroJ : J) (zeroL : L) (admissible : (A → L) → Prop) (quotient : ∀ f, admissible f → (∀ a, phiOld a=zeroJ → f a=zeroL) → ∃ beta : J → L, ∀ a, beta (phiOld a)=f a) (compositionHom : admissible (fun a => phiNew (gamma a))) (transportedKernel : ∀ a, phiOld a=zeroJ → phiNew (gamma a)=zeroL) (oldJ : ∀ x, phiOld (normOld x)=doubleJ x) : ∃ beta : J → L, (∀ a, beta (phiOld a)=phiNew (gamma a)) ∧ (∀ x, phiNew (gamma (normOld x))=beta (doubleJ x))
